messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INC#1976543210 - Canary failure spike for deployment `redwood-v2-small` in us-west-2. 5xx rate and tokenizer mismatch errors detected at ~1976543200. Paging oncall.
Sam (oncall): I'm on it. Acknowledge page, pulling up canary dashboard.
Sam (oncall): OpsBot, share the canary metric snapshot please.
OpsBot: Canary summary: 2.3% 5xx in canary (expected <0.1%), tokenization error rate 1.9% (errors like "unknown token id"). QPS ~450. Recent deploy at 1976543005 with weightset `w-2026-03-14-9f3b`.
Maya (eng-ml): I see logs showing `TokenizerMismatchError: expected vocab size 50256, got 50260` coming from model instance group a. Also embedding dim mismatch logged in a few traces.
Irene (deploy): Was there any automated weight bake step? Who promoted `w-2026-03-14-9f3b`?
Sam (oncall): Deploy history shows rollout from CI -> canary -> gradual. Promotion happened at 1976542990 via `deploy-bot promote --artifact w-2026-03-14-9f3b`.
Maya (eng-ml): Likely weightset compiled against tokenizer v3 but service config still points to tokenizer v2. Config drift between `model-serving.tokenizer` and the weights metadata.
Sam (oncall): Can we reduce customer impact by cutting canary traffic? Irene, can you flip the canary traffic routing?
Irene (deploy): Initiating traffic cut to 0% for canary group a. Running: `trafficctl set-weight canary-group-a 0`
Irene (deploy): Done. Canary QPS dropped to ~5. 5xx and tokenizer errors subsided in metrics.
Jen (CS): Any idea how many customers saw incorrect outputs? Need tally for CS and impacted SLA window.
Maya (eng-ml): Early estimate: ~12k requests in the 3 minute spike window, ~1.9% tokenization failures => ~228 impacted requests. Will run a precise query.
Maya (eng-ml): Query run: `SELECT count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE ts BETWEEN 1976543000 AND 1976543300 AND error LIKE '%TokenizerMismatch%';` returns 237.
Sam (oncall): Ok, we mitigated immediate impact by cutting traffic. Next: full rollback vs patch tokenizer config. Which is faster?
Maya (eng-ml): Fastest path is revert to previous weightset `w-2026-03-10-a1b2` that we know pairs with tokenizer v2. Patch requires rebuilding and hot-reloading tokenizer, riskier during incident.
Irene (deploy): Requesting approval to rollback canary-to-stable weights across us-west-2.
Alex (CTO): Approve rollback. Prioritize stability and notification to customers.
Sam (oncall): Rolling weights back now. Command:```deploy-bot rollback --target canary-group-a --to-weight w-2026-03-10-a1b2 --reason "tokenizer mismatch"```
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered. Progress: step1 pull weights (ok), step2 redistribute shards (in progress). Estimated finish ~2m.
OpsBot: Health checks passing on 60% of instances during rollout. No increase in 5xx so far.
Maya (eng-ml): After rollback completion, confirm tokenizer and model metadata handshake logs: `model.init: tokenizer_version=v2 weights_id=w-2026-03-10-a1b2`
Irene (deploy): Rollback finished. Canary traffic remains 0% until we validate.
Sam (oncall): Re-enable a small slice (5%) to sanity-check restored variant. `trafficctl set-weight canary-group-a 5`
OpsBot: Sanity: 0.02% 5xx, tokenizer errors 0.0% over last 60s. Looks clean.
Sam (oncall): Good. Increase to normal ramp for canary per rollback playbook. `trafficctl set-weight canary-group-a 30`
Maya (eng-ml): Root cause: automated promotion pipeline did not validate tokenizer metadata checksum against weights. The weights CI artifact had tokenizer v3 but deployment config still referenced v2. We'll add a pre-promote gate.
Sam (oncall): Feature-flag kill-switch check: is there a flag to prevent auto-promote? `model-serving.auto_promote` currently `true`. Recommend flipping to `false` until gating added.
Irene (deploy): Flipping flag now via managed flags: `ffctl set model-serving.auto_promote false` -> applied.
Irene (deploy): Also creating a short-lived kill flag to avoid accidental re-promote: `ffctl set emergency.block_promotions true`
Jen (CS): Customers affected: we have a triage list, contacting impacted accounts with initial incident note and ETA for postmortem.
Alex (CTO): Please include rollback details and number of impacted requests in customer comms. Also log commit hashes for weightset and deploy job.
Sam (oncall): Postmortem action items: 1) Add tokenizer-weight checksum gate in CI, 2) Enhance deploybot to compare weights.metadata.tokenizer_version with service config, 3) Improve canary telemetry alert thresholds, 4) Automate quick rollback path in playbook. I'll create JIRA tickets.
Maya (eng-ml): I'll own the CI gating task. Irene, can you own deploybot checks?
Irene (deploy): On it.
Sam (oncall): Handing incident to Maya for root-cause and postmortem. Closing oncall.
Maya (eng-ml): Acknowledged takeover. I'll coordinate the postmortem and include customer impact table.
pagerduty-bot: Incident #1976543210 marked: acknowledged -> resolved (metrics stabilized).
Sam (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving detailed logs and commands in the incident doc. :thumbsup:
Jen (CS): Posting initial customer note draft to #customer-updates for review.
Maya (eng-ml): Will attach tokenizer metadata diff and CI logs to the postmortem.
Irene (deploy): Creating follow-up deploy runbook PR now.
OpsBot: Incident timeline snippet:
```
1976542990 - promote command executed
1976543005 - canary traffic increased
1976543200 - alert triggered (5xx/tokenizer mismatch)
1976543220 - canary traffic set to 0%
1976543300 - rollback to w-2026-03-10-a1b2 completed
1976543380 - canary small slice sanity checks OK
1976543600 - canary ramp resumed
```
Sam (oncall): Closing thread for now. Postmortem to be linked here when ready.
